title: Viewing a student flat
objectives: Ask how much the deposit is
Ask who is responsible for repairs
Ask when you can move in

courseTemplate.setting: The deposit is one month's rent. The landlord handles structural repairs. The flat is available next Monday.

roles.learner: A student looking at a two-bedroom flat

courseTemplate.openingLine: This is the two-bedroom flat. What would you like to know?

targetPatterns.pattern: Is the deposit one month's rent?
targetPatterns.example: Is the deposit one month's rent?

targetPatterns.pattern: Who handles repairs: the landlord or the tenants?
targetPatterns.example: Who handles repairs: the landlord or the tenants?

targetPatterns.pattern: When is the earliest I could move in?
targetPatterns.example: When is the earliest I could move in?

targetPatterns.pattern: Is the rent inclusive of utilities?
targetPatterns.example: Is the rent inclusive of utilities?

targetPatterns.pattern: Could we split the cleaning rota?
targetPatterns.example: Could we split the cleaning rota?

targetPatterns.pattern: The heating hasn't been working since Monday.
targetPatterns.example: The heating hasn't been working since Monday.

targetPatterns.pattern: How much is the security deposit?
targetPatterns.example: How much is the security deposit?

targetPatterns.pattern: I need to give 30 days' notice before moving out.
targetPatterns.example: I need to give 30 days' notice before moving out.
targetPatterns.translation: 搬走前要提前 30 天通知。

stages.title: Ask how much the deposit is
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “This is the two-bedroom flat. What would you like to know?”
successCriteria: The learner can ask how much the deposit is in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Is the deposit one …”

stages.title: Ask who is responsible for repairs
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Yes, that's right. Is there anything else about the lease?”
successCriteria: The learner can ask who is responsible for repairs in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Who handles repairs: the …”

stages.title: Ask when you can move in
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “The landlord handles structural repairs. Any other questions?”
successCriteria: The learner can ask when you can move in in their own words.
hints: You can start with “When is the earliest …”
